item.text: The current flow skips metadata inspection entirely when `SkipUpdate` is set, and connection creation does not validate metadata or schema. item.text: I’ll make `shouldDownload` open and inspect an existing DB before honoring `SkipUpdate`: mismatches force a fetch when updates are allowed and produce a clear error when skipped. The final connection will independently validate its opened metadata and close on validation failures.

The change is in place and the Vuls2 package test command is still running. The existing tests cover normal age based updates and the skip flag; I’m waiting for the result and will review the final diff afterward.

Updated [db.go](/app/detector/vuls2/db.go) to report the database path on connection and metadata errors, validate metadata and schema versions, and handle schema mismatches before applying `SkipUpdate`.

`go test ./detector/vuls2` did not finish during the run, so I stopped it; the test result is unverified.
